detaileddescription.para: Some non-ascii based file systems perform encoding conversions when reading as a text file, and this function should be used if a file's bytes should be read as-is. On most filesystems, this is the same behaviour as openFileForRead.

briefdescription.para: This is a convenience method that opens a file, gets its content and then closes the file.

detaileddescription.para: The IsText parameter is used to distinguish whether the file should be opened as a binary or text file.
This will affect all following operations on this file system and may propagate down for nested file systems.

briefdescription.para: Get the working directory of this file system.

detaileddescription.para: collapse all . and .. patterns, resolve symlinks. For real file system, this uses llvm::sys::fs::real_path. This returns errc::operation_not_permitted if not implemented by subclass.
By default this uses status(), but filesystems may provide a more efficient implementation if available.

detaileddescription.para: Makes Path absolute using the current directory if it is not already. An empty Path will result in the current directory.

parameterdescription.para: A path that is modified to be an absolute path.

simplesect.para: success if path has been made absolute, otherwise a platform-specific error_code.
